summary: Full backend + frontend E2E verified for the templates/assignments split refactor. 7/7 pytest backend tests pass. UI happy path succeeded: 5 sidebar items (old nav-recurring-rules removed), Task Templates page with client-agnostic dialog, Client Assignments page with amber warning banner + disabled button when preconditions missing, assignment creation with client+template+staff selects, Generate Today's Work created a task with correct template name/staff/client, template deletion cascaded and removed the assignment. Dashboard stats returns active_templates + active_assignments (no more active_rules).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (non-blocking a11y warning, same as iteration_1)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Task.rule_id kept as legacy field — fine for backward compat but consider a data migration note.
TaskTemplateCreate used as PATCH payload — full replacement semantics (not partial). Minor concern; consistent with other endpoints.
generate_today deduplicates by assignment_id + due_date, which is correct after refactor. Older tasks tied to legacy rule_id are ignored (as expected).
No pagination on list endpoints (2000 doc cap in _list) — fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed staff/clients/templates/assignments and clean up in fixture teardown. UI test created one 'UI Test Client' + 'UI Test Task' template + assignment; template was deleted at end (cascade tested), leaving one leftover client 'UI Test Client'.

Frontend nav testids: nav-morning-cockpit, nav-todays-work, nav-client-master, nav-task-templates, nav-client-assignments. Dialog testids: template-{task-name-input,category-input,frequency-select,day-input,priority-select,active-switch,save-btn}, assignment-{client-select,template-select,staff-select,priority-select,active-switch,save-btn}.
